# Project Summary

This repository is a template for new projects. It contains a set of repo files (README.md, etc.), a `.github/` with all the Copilot and GitHub files I regularly use, a copy of Aurora (included in the `.github/` for agent access), and folders with various template files I use frequently.

It does not contain any source code, user documentation, architecture or design documentation, or other items.

Because of the unique structure and use of this repository, the you may read and write anywhere instructed.
